reason: The price is nothing for a salon my size, and I like the cash-drawer and cancelled-bill checks. But nothing here says who fixes it when billing stops on a wedding-season Sunday with 15 staff and a queue, and I won't move my whole counter off WhatsApp and paper for an app from people I don't know.
objection: If the app hangs on a Puja or wedding Sunday, my stylists can't bill and I lose money and face. Who picks up the phone then, and how fast? Also some of my staff are not comfortable in English.
would_change_my_mind: A written promise of same-day support with a local person in Bhubaneswar I can call or WhatsApp on Sundays and festival days, plus a free month's trial in a quiet season, and Odia in the app for my staff.
